xmldoc.short_description: Return the serial date number of the last day in a month.

param_input_item.param_description: Year and month numbers. Arrays are supported when the sizes are compatible with datenum and eomday.

param_output_item.param_description: A serial date number for the end of each requested month.

description.p: Return the serial date number of the last day in a month.
eomdate combines eomday with datenum, returning dates rather than day numbers.
Array-valued inputs keep their data shape when the operation supports arrays. Scalar operands are expanded where the implementation defines scalar expansion.
